text:
tay: FYI after the weekend RBAC tidy our nightly SAST/DAST job spiked alerts and we lost KMS audit entries for the CI principal. tagging @jun @ola to triage quickly. keeping thread short.

jun: saw that. quick hypothesis: suppression fetch for scanner (suppressions.json) failed due to the SA losing storage.objectViewer; KMS audit missing suggests the SA also lost cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the key.

ola: can you paste the runner error lines?

tay: runner stderr: 
```
2026-07-04T02:03:10Z scanner: unable to fetch https://config.internal/suppressions.json 403
2026-07-04T02:03:11Z scanner: failed to open artifact /tmp/artifacts/abcd: permission denied
2026-07-04T02:03:12Z key-manager: decrypt failed: permission denied
```

jun: that matches RBAC change CR-2026-07-03 which removed group:old-ci-admins from several SAs. infra-bot, can you confirm which bindings were removed?

infra-bot: CR-2026-07-03 applied by infra-ops at 2026-07-03T21:00:00Z. Removed binding: members/group:old-ci-admins --> role:roles/storage.objectViewer on bucket internal-config; removed binding: members/group:old-ci-admins --> role:roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on keyRing ci-keys.

ola: ok that explains it. mitigation: ephemeral grant to the CI SA and re-run. Prefer least-priv change: grant storage.objectViewer on bucket and cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the specific key, time-bound. Example gclouds: 
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/PRJ/locations/global/keyRing/keys/ci-secrets \
  --member=serviceAccount:ci-runner@prj.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter --condition=None

gsutil iam ch serviceAccount:ci-runner@prj.iam.gserviceaccount.com:objectViewer gs://internal-config
```

jun: also check logging sink filters; if someone excluded infra serviceAccount principals we won't see KMS audit entries. Tay, can you check the sink?

tay: quick grep shows a logging sink filter that excludes "serviceAccount:old-ci-*" for noise. infra-bot, which sink?

infra-bot: logging sink key-audit-sink exists in projects/logs-project. Filter field contains "NOT protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:serviceAccount:old-ci-*"

ola: that's too broad. action: 1) apply ephemeral grants now (30m) 2) widen sink to keep cloudkms audit events for infra SAs 3) make GH preflight step to verify suppressions fetch and key decrypt before heavy scan. I'll request infra-admin for ephemeral grant.

security-bot: created ticket SEC-4021 "ephemeral grants + sink widen + GH preflight" and linked label P2.

jun: after ephemeral grant re-run, confirm KMS shows decrypt by ci-runner and that suppression fetch succeeded. If successful, prune permanent IAM: re-add bindings to the new infra-group but scoped least-privilege and document why the group needs access.

tay: infra-admin applied ephemeral grant at 02:15. rerun finished: suppressions fetched, SAST count reduced from 60 -> 7. KMS logs now show decrypt by serviceAccount:ci-runner@prj at 02:15:31 UTC.

ola: perfect. follow-ups assigned: infra-admin INFRA-4100 widen sink and add audit proof; infra-admin INFRA-4101 permanent least-priv binding with rationale; devsec SEC-4022 GH preflight check + repo-level suppressions for generated code.

jun: small postmortem note: avoid blanket sink exclusions on serviceAccount patterns. Prefer targeted exclusions and keep key audit events.

tay: thanks all, closing after PRs linked :thumbsup:
